# vercel_monitor_webhook_notification (Resource)

Manages a link between a Vercel monitor and one existing account webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vercel_webhook" "alerts" {
  endpoint = "https://example.com/vercel-alerts"
  events   = ["alerts.triggered"]
}

resource "vercel_monitor_webhook_notification" "alerts" {
  monitor_id = "ar_xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  webhook_id = vercel_webhook.alerts.id
}
```

## Destination requirements

Each resource owns one link. Do not manage the same monitor and webhook pair in multiple Terraform resources or states.

The webhook must subscribe to `alerts.triggered`, must not set `project_ids`, and must be owned by the account. Configure it separately with `vercel_webhook`, then pass its ID to `webhook_id`.

The special `ar_default` monitor ID is supported even though the default monitor itself cannot be managed by `vercel_monitor`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_id` (String) The ID of the monitor. Use `ar_default` to manage a notification destination for the team's default monitor.
- `webhook_id` (String) The ID of an existing account webhook subscribed to the `alerts.triggered` event.

### Optional

- `minimum_severity_level` (String) Set to `critical` to notify this destination only when an alert is classified as Critical. For custom alert rules, Critical is assigned after the agent investigation completes. Omit to notify this destination at every severity.
- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team that owns the monitor and notification destination. Required if a default team is not configured in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this webhook notification link. Format: `monitor_id/webhook_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# If a default team is configured in the provider, import using:
terraform import vercel_monitor_webhook_notification.alerts ar_xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/hook_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

# Otherwise, prefix the import ID with the team ID:
terraform import vercel_monitor_webhook_notification.alerts team_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/ar_xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/hook_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
